newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chubais to handle key Russian foreign ties.
newsitem.headline: Chubais to handle key Russian foreign ties.

text.p: First Deputy Prime Minister Anatoly Chubais, in charge of economic policy in Russia's new cabinet, will handle relations with international financial organisations and the Group of Seven industrialised countries, Interfax news agency said on Friday.

It said a decree from President Boris Yeltsin appointed Chubais as head of the commission handling these relations. He replaced former first deputy prime minister Vladimir Potanin who was dropped from the cabinet.
Chubais, who is finance minister, will become Russia's governor at the World Bank, it said.
